notes.title: Dolguth November Update is available !
notes.notes:
Added the first BIO-Mech (Durgai) and its pilot (Moog-Fen)

Added the climbers leaderboard. Run the cliffhanger mode in single player and try to be the fastest. The challenge ends when the player enter the Cargo on top of the map.

Various improvements in the Dungeon mode

notes.title: First Early-Access Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Dolguth is now officially available as Early-Access.

Plug your joysticks and test it, we want your feedback.

Expect more infos soon
